chapter: Early bands and joining George Lewis
title: Reverend Kershaw and the band's overseas trip plans
summary: Watkins and Russell discuss Reverend Kershaw, letters from his secretary, a misunderstanding with Miss Tate and the George Lewis band's trip and travel abroad.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, somebody told me a few months ago, Reverend Kershaw was a professor. Did you ever hear any of them?

No, because I got a letter from his secretary a week before last. Oh good, then he still. Yeah, you see, because I always write to her and she writes to me. And whenever she tell me he ain't too busy, well, I write to him.
You see, I got a card from him for Christmas. Well, I ain't heard from him since that.

Well, she, you see, she told me that they had been very busy. Mm-hmm. And he had tried to get the band out there before George left, but I don't know, there was some misunderstanding between, with Miss Tate, I don't know what happened. But anyhow, Miss Tate wrote and told me that she wasn't any too optimistic about the job. Now, I don't know what the terms was about. So, I said, well, that's just a dead issue until they come back. So, I know, I'm more than sure when they come back why something will be worked out because the secretary wrote and told me that he's waiting on Miss Tate when she come back. She don't let him know why, for me to write and let him know when they get back. But anyway, to finish talking about George Lewis, I've been traveling all over with him. That's in the place I haven't been with him yet. Been overseas when they played here in America, practically every state in the union here. And, well, I'm expecting to hear some good news from him when they come back off of this trip because, you see, they trying to work up some deals while they're over there. Well, I'm more than sure because from the letters that I've been getting from over there, I think that's what's going to happen most likely to go back this summer.
Sure, they'd like to have the whole band.
